items.title: Report alleges roughly 20 glide bombs hit Zaporizhzhia bridges and Dnipro hydroelectric plant
items.summary: A Russian military-linked report claims about 20 glide bombs struck bridges and the Dnipro Hydroelectric Power Plant in Zaporizhzhia within an hour. The account adds specific alleged targets and a strike count to earlier reports of explosions near the city's bridges, but gives no damage or casualty figures.
